text:
Qatar Airways is the best-supported answer for the world’s favourite airline, having won Skytrax’s passenger-voted “World’s Best Airline” more often than any other carrier in recent years. Singapore Airlines is the usual closest rival in those rankings, and there is no single official global title beyond awards like these. British Airways’ old line “The World’s Favourite Airline” was an advertising slogan, not a measured result.
